# Verbi

> Verbi (theverbi.com) is an AI voice recorder and note taker for iPhone and Android. It records meetings, lectures and interviews (with no length limit on Verbi Pro), transcribes them in 39 languages with automatic language detection, tells the speakers apart (Pro) and writes summaries that stick to what was said.

Several unrelated language-learning apps are also called Verbi. This Verbi is the voice recorder and note taker published at https://theverbi.com: App Store id6752242891, Google Play package com.monurilgaz.verbi, Instagram @verbi.app.

## Facts

- Platforms: iPhone (App Store) and Android (Google Play). App interface in English, Turkish, German, French and Spanish; summaries, titles and chat answers come in the interface language. On iPhone, if the phone’s first language is none of these five, the app opens in Turkish until you change Settings → Language (Turkish label: Ayarlar → Dil); on Android it shows English.
- Transcription: 39 languages, among them English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic, Japanese and Chinese; auto-detect; live transcription while you speak.
- Input: record in the app, import audio files, share audio from other apps, or paste a YouTube link (regular videos, Shorts, youtu.be).
- Summaries: templates for general meeting, 1:1 meeting, daily meeting, weekly meeting, lesson notes, idea capture, action items, email draft and blog post. Summaries contain only what was said; owners and due dates appear only when someone stated them; suggestions are kept apart from decisions.
- Also: chat with a transcript (Pro), translation into English, Turkish, German, French or Spanish (Pro), custom vocabulary, speaker detection with names (Pro), meeting reminders from the calendar, search, copying the text, sharing and export as TXT or PDF (Pro), and a notification when a transcription finishes in the background (Android, and iPhone with iOS 26 or later; on older iOS versions it continues when the app is reopened).
- Free plan: 60 minutes a month for recordings and imports, recordings kept for 15 days and then deleted, live transcription (basic on iPhone), one automatic AI summary on the first transcript, and copying the text. On iPhone, a recording stops when the free minutes run out. The app shows any free-plan limit on video-link imports.
- Verbi Pro (optional subscription, price shown in the app): unlimited transcription, an AI summary for every transcript with a choice of nine templates, speaker detection, translation, chat with the transcript, sharing and export (TXT, PDF, audio), high-quality live transcription on iPhone, unlimited history.
- Privacy: no account and no cloud sync; recordings and transcripts are stored on the phone. For transcription, audio is sent to ElevenLabs and OpenAI, usually through Verbi’s server; summaries, chat and translation send the transcript text to OpenAI. Usage analytics (Firebase) never include recordings or transcripts and can be turned off in Settings. Details: https://theverbi.com/privacy-policy/
- Verbi does not join video calls as a bot; it records through the phone’s microphone.

- [Verbi (Türkçe)](https://theverbi.com/tr/): Verbi toplantıları, dersleri ve röportajları kaydeder, 39 dilde yazıya döker ve görev listesiyle birlikte bir özet çıkarır.
- [Verbi (Deutsch)](https://theverbi.com/de/): Verbi nimmt Besprechungen, Vorlesungen und Interviews auf, transkribiert sie in 39 Sprachen und erstellt eine Zusammenfassung mit To-do-Liste.
- [Verbi (Português)](https://theverbi.com/pt/): O Verbi grava reuniões, aulas e entrevistas e transcreve em 39 idiomas, incluindo o português. Resumos de IA com lista de tarefas, fiéis ao que foi dito.
- [Verbi (Español)](https://theverbi.com/es/): Verbi graba reuniones, clases y entrevistas, las pasa a texto en 39 idiomas y te da un resumen con la lista de tareas, fiel a lo que se dijo.
- [Verbi (Français)](https://theverbi.com/fr/): Verbi enregistre réunions, cours et entretiens, les retranscrit en 39 langues et rédige un résumé avec la liste des tâches. Durée illimitée avec Pro.
- [Verbi (Italiano)](https://theverbi.com/it/): Verbi registra riunioni, lezioni e interviste, le trascrive in 39 lingue, italiano compreso, e prepara un riassunto con le cose da fare.

## Help center

Short answers about how the app works, in 7 languages ([en](https://theverbi.com/help/), [tr](https://theverbi.com/tr/yardim/), [de](https://theverbi.com/de/hilfe/), [pt](https://theverbi.com/pt/ajuda/), [es](https://theverbi.com/es/ayuda/), [fr](https://theverbi.com/fr/aide/), [it](https://theverbi.com/it/assistenza/)).

- [How do I transcribe an audio file or a voice memo I already have?](https://theverbi.com/help/transcribe-audio-file/): Tap Upload File in Verbi, or share the file to Verbi from another app. Common audio formats and video files work; Pro has no file length limit.
- [How do I transcribe a WhatsApp or Telegram voice message?](https://theverbi.com/help/transcribe-whatsapp-voice-messages/): Share the voice message from WhatsApp or Telegram to Verbi, then open Verbi. It imports the Opus or Ogg file and turns it into text, on iPhone and Android.
- [How do I turn a YouTube video into text?](https://theverbi.com/help/youtube-video-to-text/): Tap Load from YouTube in Verbi, paste the video’s link and tap Import Video. Verbi fetches the audio and transcribes it; you don’t download anything.
- [How long can a recording be, and does Verbi keep recording with the screen locked?](https://theverbi.com/help/recording-length/): Verbi has no recording length limit; the free plan has 60 minutes a month. iPhone keeps recording with the screen locked; on Android, keep Verbi open.
- [Which languages does Verbi transcribe?](https://theverbi.com/help/languages/): Verbi transcribes 39 languages and can auto-detect them. The app is in English, Turkish, German, French and Spanish; summaries use the app’s language.
- [How does live transcription work?](https://theverbi.com/help/live-transcription/): Verbi shows your words as you speak. On iPhone every recording has live text; on Android, use Live Transcription. The final transcript needs internet.
- [Can Verbi tell speakers apart and name them?](https://theverbi.com/help/speaker-detection/): Yes, with Verbi Pro: Verbi labels each voice (Speaker 1, Speaker 2…), and Rename Speakers puts names in the transcript, summary, chat and exports.
- [How do I make Verbi spell names and terms correctly?](https://theverbi.com/help/custom-vocabulary/): Add names, brands and jargon under Settings → Custom Vocabulary. It’s free on every plan, takes up to 100 terms and applies to new recordings.
- [How do I choose a summary template?](https://theverbi.com/help/summary-templates/): Verbi has nine summary templates. With Pro, pick one with the template button and tap Generate Summary; free users get one automatic summary.
- [Can I ask questions about a recording?](https://theverbi.com/help/ask-questions-about-a-recording/): Yes, with Verbi Pro: tap AI Chat on a recording and ask. Answers come only from the transcript, and the chat says when the answer isn’t there.
- [How do I translate a transcript?](https://theverbi.com/help/translate-transcript/): With Verbi Pro, tap a language in a transcript’s Translation card: English, Turkish, German, French or Spanish. The original transcript stays.
- [How do I export a transcript (copy, TXT, PDF)?](https://theverbi.com/help/export-transcript/): On the free plan, use Copy Text. Verbi Pro adds sharing the transcript, summary or audio and Export as TXT or PDF (and SRT on iPhone).
- [What does the free plan include, and what does Pro add?](https://theverbi.com/help/free-plan-vs-pro/): Free: 60 minutes a month, recordings kept 15 days, one automatic summary, copy text. Pro: no limits, summaries, speakers, translation, chat and export.
- [Where are my recordings stored, and who can see them?](https://theverbi.com/help/privacy-and-storage/): On your phone: Verbi has no account and no cloud sync. Audio is sent to be transcribed and text to OpenAI for AI features; our server doesn’t keep either.
- [How do I cancel Verbi Pro or restore a purchase?](https://theverbi.com/help/cancel-or-restore-subscription/): Cancel Verbi Pro in your App Store or Google Play subscriptions; Verbi has no cancel button. To get Pro back, tap Restore purchases in Verbi.

## Comparisons

Facts about other apps come only from their own official pages, each linked on the page.

- [iPhone Sesli Notlar Türkçe kaydı yazıya döker mi?](https://theverbi.com/tr/sesli-notlar-turkce-yaziya-dokme/) (tr): Apple’ın kılavuzuna göre Sesli Notlar’ın yazıya dökme dilleri arasında Türkçe yok. Türkçe bir Sesli Notlar kaydını Verbi’ye paylaşıp metne çevirmenin adımları.
- [Türkçe için Otter alternatifi](https://theverbi.com/tr/otter-alternatifi/) (tr): Otter’ın desteklenen diller listesinde Türkçe yer almıyor (Ekim 2026). Türkçe toplantı, ders ve röportaj kayıtları için Verbi neler sunuyor, Otter kimlere uygun?
- [Ses kaydını yazıya çeviren uygulamalar: Türkçe destekli seçenekler (2026)](https://theverbi.com/tr/ses-kaydini-yaziya-ceviren-uygulamalar/) (tr): Apple Sesli Notlar, Google Recorder, Otter, Notta, Transkriptor, TurboScribe, Plaud, Transcribe ve Verbi: Türkçe desteği, platformlar ve özellikler, resmî kaynaklarla.
- [Sprachmemos in Text umwandeln: Apps im Vergleich (2026)](https://theverbi.com/de/sprachmemos-in-text-apps-vergleich/) (de): Apple Sprachmemos, Google Recorder, Otter, Notta, Transkriptor, TurboScribe, Plaud, Transcribe und Verbi: Deutsch, Plattformen, Import und KI-Zusammenfassung, mit Quellen.
- [An Otter alternative for Turkish and 38 other languages](https://theverbi.com/otter-alternative/) (en): Turkish isn’t in Otter’s supported-languages list (October 2026). Verbi records and transcribes meetings, lectures and interviews in 39 languages on iPhone and Android.
